name: com.newswithoutpictures/news
title: News Without Pictures
description: Today's verified news in one call: eight sourced stories, twice daily. No key. ChatGPT-ready.

tools.name: get_latest_edition
tools.description: The latest edition of News Without Pictures: the eight most important verified news stories right now, each in two paragraphs with sources. Published at 7 a.m. and 5 p.m. New York time. Use this to answer 'what's in the news today?'

tools.name: get_story
tools.description: One story by its slug, with sources and any corrections.

slug.description: The story slug, from an edition or a story URL.

tools.name: list_editions
tools.description: Recent editions (id, name, publication time), newest first.

tools.name: get_edition
tools.description: A past edition by id, for example 2026-11-24-morning.

tools.name: search_stories
tools.description: Search published stories by keyword. Returns matching headlines, dates and links, newest first.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search News Without Pictures stories by keyword (all words must match). An empty query returns the latest edition's stories. Returns JSON {results:[{id,title,url}]}; pass an id to fetch for the full story.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: The full text of one News Without Pictures story by id (its slug, from search). Returns JSON {id,title,text,url,metadata} with sources and corrections.
